description: Product, building, and infrastructure material stocks dataset for 337 Chinese cities between 1978 and 2020 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xiang Li et al. Reliable city-level product, building, and infrastructure material stocks data can help describe historical material use patterns, benchmark material efficiency, and estimate future recycling potentials. However, such urban material stocks data are often limited, due primarily to unavailable, inconsistent, or noncontinuous city-level statistics. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2023. Formats: Excel. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
